Formats collected from primary documentation (recorded in Desktop/GitRepo/REFERENCES.md 2026-08-15):
microsoft/security-utilities HighConfidenceSecurityModels.json, MIT (AAD client-app secret:
three alphabet characters, a 7Q~ or 8Q~ signature, then 31-34 more over A-Za-z0-9 ~ . _ -);
docs.cloud.google.com docs/authentication/api-keys (the documented example key string is
AIza plus 35 characters over A-Za-z0-9 _ -);
github.blog announcing-npms-new-access-token-format (npm prefix, underscore delimiter, Base62
alphabet, last six characters a CRC32 checksum, 178 bits of entropy = 36 characters after the prefix).
